# blast-radius

> Use before shipping or approving a change whose diff looks small but whose effects may reach past it — "what could this break", "blast radius of X", "is this safe to merge", or a reviewer who does not trust a short diff. Finds breakage that grep does not show (library internals, timing, wire formats, DB columns, flags, other languages reading the same data) and proves the single fact the change is safe because of by running real code. Not for listing callers or for full code review.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/blast-radius
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/blast-radius
```

then run `apm install`.
